dressipi.idf: log((1+catalogue_size)/(1+attribute_document_frequency))+1; weighted Jaccard over chronological views with 0.8 decay; ties frozen purchase count then ID

m5.calibration: expanding earlier nonoverlapping complete forecast residuals; item/category and horizon-week pools; aggregate residual pools separate by series
m5.quantile: order statistic ceil((n+1)*coverage), reject if rank > n
m5.stability_groups: category; zero fraction in past 56 days >= 0.5; forecast weeks 1..4
